stem:
Shakira has an investment account that she deposits $200.00 into each year. The table shows the amount of interest she earns in dollars and the ending balance each year.

Shakira continues to deposit $200.00 each year and earns the same interest rate for several years. Which statement about the ending balance each year is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The balance increases by 2% of the sum of $200.00 and $204.00 every year.

options.label: B
options.text: The balance increases by 2% of $200.00 every year.

options.label: C
options.text: The balance increases by 2% of the prior year's ending balance.

options.label: D
options.text: The balance increases by 2% of the sum of the prior year's ending balance and $200.00.
